title: Heim, Dröscher and Hauser's two forms of gravity

tellings.quote: two guys named Rusher and Hauser. Okay. They also believe in two forms of gravity.

plain: A German physicist named Burkhard Heim, and after him two researchers Michels names as Dröscher (he says "Rusher") and Hauser, are said to have believed that gravity comes in two forms rather than one. Michels mentions this himself in a conversation with a guest named Dave Rossi, without naming a source or explaining the theory. If true, gravity would not be the single force physics textbooks describe.
